name: Refusing To Pay Debt
overview: Scripture teaches that debt creates a form of bondage, as the borrower becomes a servant to the lender, emphasizing the importance of financial responsibility and freedom (Proverbs 22:7). Christians are called to avoid owing anything to others except the continuing debt of love, which fulfills God's law (Romans 13:8). This principle reflects God's greater love demonstrated through Christ's sacrifice, inviting believers to live in grace and integrity rather than under the burden of unpaid obligations (John 3:16).
